representation.assignment_fields: section, control (canonical template key), target, message_type (control-change|note), number, channel; map_mode for continuous controls; button_kind (momentary|toggle) for buttons
representation.device_parameter_banks: 1 or 2 when at least one encoder assignment is enabled, else null
representation.note: project comparison representation, not a Live API or recovered structure; derivation IDs are analyst-only and must be removed for a handoff
